title: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: For this part,you are allowed 30 minutes to write on the topic Changes in the Way of Education.You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Education is undergoing a profound transformation. Not long ago, learning meant sitting in a fixed classroom and listening to a teacher; today it is being reshaped by technology into something far more flexible and personal. In my view, these changes make education more open and effective than ever before. The clearest sign of this shift is the rise of online and blended learning. During and after the pandemic, millions of students turned to video lectures and learning apps, so that a lesson could be paused, replayed and studied at one's own pace. Meanwhile, artificial intelligence now recommends exercises based on each learner's weak points, transforming a one-size-fits-all lecture into tailored guidance. These tools break the old limits of time and place and let knowledge reach anyone with a phone. Admittedly, no screen can fully replace a caring teacher. Yet the direction is clear: education is moving from rigid instruction toward flexible, learner-centred study. If we embrace these tools wisely, learning will become both wider in reach and deeper in quality.
keyPoints: 今昔对比开篇并表态。本段落实了首段功能：用 Not long ago, learning meant... today it is being reshaped 的今昔对比切入变化，再以 In my view, these changes make education more open and effective 亮明正向态度，紧扣 Changes in the Way of Education 又为全文定调。
主题句领两例并小结。本段落实了主体论证：主题句 The clearest sign of this shift is the rise of online and blended learning 领起，例一讲视频课与 App，Meanwhile 过渡到例二 AI 个性 化，末句 These tools break the old limits 小结回扣中心，做到有例有评、层次清楚。
让步转折收束展望。本段落实了尾段功能：Admittedly, no screen can fully replace a caring teacher 先让步，Yet the direction is clear 转折重申立场，末句 If we embrace these tools wisely 给出展望，呼应首段态度、闭环收尾。
